pull_request.title: Retry idempotent charge creation on gateway timeouts
pull_request.author: kwame-a

gate.reason: 1 finding carries a repro test that passes at base and fails at head.

findings.title: Name the retry limit in create_charge_with_retry() instead of the literal 3
findings.body_markdown: The loop bound `3` (line 13) is the same limit `_is_retryable()` reads from config.

severity.explanation: sensitive path × reachable internally × file tested, symbol not × unproven × blast radius 0.40 × churn 0.40

findings.title: Each retry sends a new idempotency key, so a timed-out charge can be taken twice
findings.body_markdown: `create_charge_with_retry()` builds the idempotency key inside the retry loop (line 15), so every attempt sends a different one. When the gateway times out after it has already created the charge, the retry creates a second charge and the customer pays twice for one order.

severity.explanation: sensitive path × proven × reachable internally × file tested, symbol not × blast radius 0.40 × churn 0.40

    def test_retry_reuses_the_idempotency_key():
        gateway = TimesOutOnce()
        create_charge_with_retry({"amount_minor": 1200, "currency": "usd"}, client=gateway)
        first, second = gateway.keys

findings.title: Cap the retry backoff in _backoff(); the twelfth attempt sleeps for 34 minutes
findings.body_markdown: `_backoff()` returns `0.5 * 2 ** attempt` seconds with no ceiling (line 33). `MAX_ATTEMPTS` comes from config, and at the configured 12 the last sleep is 2048 seconds, held on the request thread that is serving the checkout.

severity.explanation: sensitive path × reachable internally × unproven × churn 0.40 × blast radius 0.10

findings.title: Rename `record_attempt()` so the name says it has a side effect
findings.body_markdown: `record_attempt()` writes as well as reads; the name reads like a pure lookup.

findings.title: Guard `_is_retryable()` against two callers running it at once
findings.body_markdown: Two workers running `_is_retryable()` together could each overwrite the other's result.

findings.title: Add a regression test for `create_charge_with_retry()`
findings.body_markdown: No test exercises the path in `create_charge_with_retry()` that this change breaks.
